title: 17-year-old proposes hybrid nuclear system to cut Antarctic CO₂ emissions by 3,254 tons
summary_full: A young Chilean student has proposed an innovative energy system for Antarctica. This concept combines renewable sources with a nuclear microreactor for reliable power.  The system aims to significantly reduce diesel fuel dependence and carbon emissions.  It offers a potential solution for powering remote research stations in extreme conditions.  This student-led idea highlights future possibilities for sustainable Antarctic energy.
